results.corrected_title: Palo Alto Networks to buy AI startup Applied Compute for $4.5B in all-stock deal
results.corrected_summary: Palo Alto Networks announced on 18 November 2026 that it will acquire Applied Compute in an all-stock transaction valued at $4.5 billion, subject to adjustments. Applied Compute is a platform for post-training and inference of open-weight AI models. Co-founder and CEO Yash Patil will become Co-Chief AI Officer at Palo Alto Networks once the deal closes. Closing is expected in Palo Alto's fiscal Q3 2027, subject to customary conditions including regulatory clearance.
key_facts: Applied Compute: platform for post-training and inference of open-weight AI models
CEO Yash Patil becomes Co-Chief AI Officer at closing
Closing expected in fiscal Q3 2027 (Feb-Apr 2027), subject to regulatory clearance
